item.title: Phillies’ Future Infielder Sends Bo Bichette Message After $126 Million Decision
item.description: NEW YORK, NEW YORK - JULY 31: Bo Bichette #19 of the New York Mets looks on duing the game against the Miami Marlins at Citi Field on July 31, 2026 in New York City. (Photo by Evan Bernstein/Getty Images) Getty Images The Philadelphia Phillies are heading into an offseason with important questions about their infield, including whether Trea Turner will remain at shortstop after a difficult defensive season. Turner’s future could become a defining storyline as the Phillies try to keep their championship window open. The club also has potential changes at third base to consider, with Alec Bohm entering free agency and top prospect Aidan Miller pushing toward the major leagues after missing most of 2026 with a back injury. Miller’s potential role next season — which could come at shortstop or third base depending on how things proceed — as well as some high-profile contract negotiations from last offseason, made his recent message about his baseball role model particularly interesting. “Miller, who models his game after former Phillies free-agent target Bo Bichette, is playing third base in the Fall League, a potential precursor to replacing free agent Alec Bohm,” Scott Lauber relayed for The Philadelphia Inquirer . “But (president of baseball operations Dave) Dombrowski also met with Turner this week and issued what amounted to an ultimatum: Improve your defense, or get moved off shortstop.” FORBES | By Peter Chawaga Mets Veteran Shortstop Cuts Ties With Team Shortly After Disappointing Season Philadelphia Phillies’ Mimics Bo Bichette With Shortstop, Third Base Opportunities Ahead Dombrowski made it very clear that Miller could factor into the Phillies’ big-league plans as they evaluate their infield for 2027. The prospect’s ability to handle both shortstop and third base gives the club options, although his eventual position will depend on the roster’s needs and his development. “Shortstop Trea Turner could be asked to move to the outfield, although it is unclear if those conversations will take place,” Todd Zolecki wrote for MLB.com . “Miller is playing third base this fall, which is an AFL roster/playing time consideration more than it is a signal of the Phillies’ future plans for him. He could play third and short next year as he pushes for a promotion.” Miller’s return to the field after a lengthy injury absence has added urgency to the discussion. The 22-year-old prospect has an opportunity to make up for lost development time and potentially push for a major-league role next season. Still, the Phillies have not committed to replacing Turner, and Miller’s fall assignment alone does not guarantee a position change. The former Toronto Blue Jays shortstop sign
item.content:encoded: NEW YORK, NEW YORK - JULY 31: Bo Bichette #19 of the New York Mets looks on duing the game against the Miami Marlins at Citi Field on July 31, 2026 in New York City. (Photo by Evan Bernstein/Getty Images) Getty Images The Philadelphia Phillies are heading into an offseason with important questions about their infield, including whether Trea Turner will remain at shortstop after a difficult defensive season. Turner’s future could become a defining storyline as the Phillies try to keep their championship window open. The club also has potential changes at third base to consider, with Alec Bohm entering free agency and top prospect Aidan Miller pushing toward the major leagues after missing most of 2026 with a back injury. Miller’s potential role next season — which could come at shortstop or third base depending on how things proceed — as well as some high-profile contract negotiations from last offseason, made his recent message about his baseball role model particularly interesting. “Miller, who models his game after former Phillies free-agent target Bo Bichette, is playing third base in the Fall League, a potential precursor to replacing free agent Alec Bohm,” Scott Lauber relayed for The Philadelphia Inquirer . “But (president of baseball operations Dave) Dombrowski also met with Turner this week and issued what amounted to an ultimatum: Improve your defense, or get moved off shortstop.” FORBES | By Peter Chawaga Mets Veteran Shortstop Cuts Ties With Team Shortly After Disappointing Season Philadelphia Phillies’ Mimics Bo Bichette With Shortstop, Third Base Opportunities Ahead Dombrowski made it very clear that Miller could factor into the Phillies’ big-league plans as they evaluate their infield for 2027. The prospect’s ability to handle both shortstop and third base gives the club options, although his eventual position will depend on the roster’s needs and his development. “Shortstop Trea Turner could be asked to move to the outfield, although it is unclear if those conversations will take place,” Todd Zolecki wrote for MLB.com . “Miller is playing third base this fall, which is an AFL roster/playing time consideration more than it is a signal of the Phillies’ future plans for him. He could play third and short next year as he pushes for a promotion.” Miller’s return to the field after a lengthy injury absence has added urgency to the discussion. The 22-year-old prospect has an opportunity to make up for lost development time and potentially push for a major-league role next season. Still, the Phillies have not committed to replacing Turner, and Miller’s fall assignment alone does not guarantee a position change. FORBES | By Peter Chawaga Dodgers Castoff Catcher Abruptly Ends Career Immediately After Season Ends Philadelphia Phillies Seek Infield Changes After Bo Bichette’s $126 Million Contract Move The Bichette comparison also recalls a significant missed opportunity for Philadelphia last winter. The former Toronto Blue Jays shortstop signed a short-term contract with the New York Mets after declining the Phillies’ pursuit. “A year ago, the Phillies reportedly offered Bichette close to $200 million over eight seasons, but he turned it down knowing a three-year, $126 million contract could set him up to make significantly more than $200 million over that same eight-year period,” Anthony DiComo noted for MLB.com . Bichette’s decision left the Phillies without the star infield addition it had targeted, while his move to third base in New York underscored the positional flexibility that Miller seeks to emulate. Now, Miller represents a potential in-house solution. If Turner remains at shortstop, Miller could still compete for time at third base, particularly if Bohm departs. If Turner moves elsewhere, Miller’s defensive experience at shortstop could become more important. This article was originally published on Forbes.com

item.title: Today on Pinstripe Alley – 10/19/26
item.description: CLEVELAND, OHIO - OCTOBER 18: Manager Stephen Vogt of the Cleveland Guardians signals for a pitching change during the fourth inning against the Tampa Bay Rays in game five of the American League Championship Series at Progressive Field on October 18, 2026 in Cleveland, Ohio. (Photo by Jason Miller/Getty Images) | Getty Images The World Series matchup isn’t set in stone just yet, but Tampa Bay took a major step towards being the one that will face Milwaukee in the Fall Classic. They took two out of three in Cleveland to return home with a 3-2 series lead heading into a big Game 6 tonight, where they’ll start Freddy Peralta who has been dealing this postseason while the Guardians will scramble to piece their way through a bullpen game after having to get 21 outs from their relievers yesterday. Thanks to the postponed Game 4 eating up the travel day, even if they do win tonight they’ll also be forced to play the potential do-or-die Game 7 on four straight days without a night off — it’s not looking pretty for Cleveland, to say the least. We’ve got a full slate for you ahead of this critical Game 6 later tonight, starting with Jake’s recap of Game 5’s action in the Roundup. Michael hands out a stellar grade to David Bednar to kick off our annual Report Card series, and Kevin recalls Sandy Alomar Sr. and his days with the Yankees on his birthday. Then in the afternoon Jonathan goes over the Yankees’ longest home runs of the season and Estevao reflects on the gap between Giancarlo Stanton and 500 career home runs before I return to open up the mailbag for more of your questions. Today’s Playoff Matchup: American League Championship Series Game 6 (Rays lead series, 3-2) Cleveland Guardians vs. Tampa Bay Rays Time: 8:00 p.m. EST TV: TBS/HBO Max/truTV Venue: Tropicana Field, St. Petersburg, FL Questions/Prompts: 1. With their bullpen depleted ahead of a bullpen game, does Cleveland need a miracle to extend the ALCS or will we see a competitive game? 2. Are you ready for the Knicks’ season opener and banner presentation tomorrow night?

item.title: C.J. Stroud’s fourth-quarter comeback kept the Texans alive against Jacksonville
item.description: C.J. Stroud’s fourth-quarter comeback kept the Texans alive against Jacksonville originally appeared on The Sporting News . Add The Sporting News as a Preferred Source by clicking here . The Houston Texans left London with a win that looked unlikely late in the game. Ka’imi Fairbairn’s 49-yard field goal as time expired completed a 34-31 comeback against the Jacksonville Jaguars and gave Houston one of the most dramatic finishes of Week 6. C.J. Stroud was central to the rally. He passed for 312 yards and three touchdowns, repeatedly giving Houston a chance to stay within reach after Jacksonville threatened to take control. The result is especially important because the Texans entered the game with a 1-4 record. A loss would have made the path back into the AFC South race more difficult. Instead, Houston moved to 2-4 and handed Jacksonville its second defeat. A wild finish in London The game was not decided until the final possession. Houston’s offense put the Texans in position for Fairbairn, who converted the 49-yard attempt to secure the victory. The kick capped a game in which both teams had opportunities to seize control. WHAT A THROW FROM CJ STROUD. HOUvsJAX on NFL Network Stream on @NFLPlus https://t.co/Z8LUxZceAl — NFL (@NFL) October 18, 2026 Jacksonville’s offense had enough success to put up 31 points, but the Jaguars could not close the door. Stroud’s three touchdown passes kept Houston in the game, and the Texans found the final points they needed when the pressure was highest. A road win in an international game can also complicate preparation and routine. Houston had to manage the travel and the unusual setting while facing a divisional opponent that came in with a far stronger record. MORE : Browns’ defense flips the script as Cleveland stuns Ravens The Texans have something to build on One win does not fix Houston’s uneven start, but a last-second victory against a 4-1 team gives the Texans a meaningful result to carry into next week. Stroud’s production is an encouraging sign, particularly after the team needed a high-pressure finish. For Jacksonville, the loss will sting because the Jaguars had a chance to strengthen their grip on the division. Instead, the final kick flipped the story. The Texans now have a result that can change the mood around their season. They still have work to do, but Sunday’s finish showed they can respond when a game reaches its most demanding moment. More NFL news: Joey Porter Jr. news considered ‘good’ after Steelers trade JJ McCarthy gets major starting job prediction despite New York’s 3-1 start Vikings get positive Justin Jefferson update after making wise decision against Dolphins

item.title: Markus Krösche set to become AC Milan’s new Head of Football
item.description: Markus Krösche set to become AC Milan’s new Head of Football As reported by Kicker , Markus Krösche is set to become AC Milan’s new Head of Football. On Sunday evening, the bombshell spread like wildfire around German football – Markus Krösche is to leave his role as Eintracht Frankfurt Sporting Director with immediate effect. The 46-year-old asked if he could be released from his duties, stating that he “needed a change.” The change in question appears to be a move to Serie A and AC Milan as their new Head of Football. Krösche’s departure had been rumoured last summer, but nothing materialised. However, the iron is now hot, and an official agreement with Milan is expected to be announced this week. Milan already had Krösche in their sights last summer, offering him a four-year deal totalling up to €40m. As stated in Gazzetta dello Sport , these discussions never went away; instead, both parties were just trying to come to an agreement when it came to the job, its duties, and, of course, finances. Eintracht Frankfurt to Receive Transfer Fee for Markus Krösche The one plus side in all of this for Frankfurt is that they will receive a transfer fee should Krösche move to Milan. The 46-year-old is under contract until 2028 and would therefore need to be bought out of his current deal. How much Milan are willing to spend is not yet known. GGFN | Jamie Allen

item.title: Clemson Dominates Charleston Southern Despite Offensive Ineptitude
item.description: CLEMSON, SC - OCTOBER 17: Clemson Tigers head coach Dabo Swinney congratulates his offense after they scored a touchdown during a college football game between the Charleston Southern Buccaneers and the Clemson Tigers on October 17, 2026 at Clemson Memorial Stadium in Clemson, S.C. (Photo by John Byrum/Icon Sportswire via Getty Images) | Icon Sportswire via Getty Images Clemson hosted Charleston Southern in a game that was always a question about how much they would win by, not if they would ever win. Thankfully Clemson’s defense showed up for all four quarters while the offensive continued to be here in name only. Thankfully it was enough for a 37-0 victory. We always caution about taking away too many positives from cupcake games. But the defense absolutely get credit. A shutout with only 76 yards of offense allowed is always a great day. Yes, Charleston Southern had a great set of scripted plays on the first drive and a few other opportunities lost due to drops and other miscues, but defense did exactly what they needed to. The offense, well it really is hard to say much beyond “They stink”. Sure we can all talk about a season high in scoring, but the truth is the Tigers scored 30 points against an FCS team. And for our starters that’s only 27 points. Against an FCS team. That’s not great. Sure put on a nice face in public, but even factoring in Dabo’s desire to not embarrass teams this is a bad performance. This offense had a single explosive play with the starters in, a 32-yard pass to Bentancur. There were only 2 other passes that exceeded 10 yards, going for 11 and 10 yards respectively. This is not an explosive offense. Much like the last 5 years this is an occasionally efficient offense. That doesn’t win games against top teams. It barely wins you games against the middle of the pack. Sustaining a drive that consists of solely 3-5 yard plays just isn’t going to work. Top line stats look fine. 400 yards of offense, close to 50% on third downs, and nearly 30 first downs. Everyone loves those numbers, but it should mean more than 37 points. Hey at least special teams got some points, more efficient than our offense too. Buckly up for Virginia Tech, it could get ugly again.

We always caution about taking away too many positives from cupcake games. But the defense absolutely get credit. A shutout with only 76 yards of offense allowed is always a great day. Yes, Charleston Southern had a great set of scripted plays on the first drive and a few other opportunities lost due to drops and other miscues, but defense did exactly what they needed to. The offense, well it really is hard to say much beyond “They stink”. Sure we can all talk about a season high in scoring, but the truth is the Tigers scored 30 points against an FCS team. And for our starters that’s only 27 points. Against an FCS team. That’s not great. Sure put on a nice face in public, but even factoring in Dabo’s desire to not embarrass teams this is a bad performance. This offense had a single explosive play with the starters in, a 32-yard pass to Bentancur. There were only 2 other passes that exceeded 10 yards, going for 11 and 10 yards respectively. This is not an explosive offense. Much like the last 5 years this is an occasionally efficient offense. That doesn’t win games against top teams. It barely wins you games against the middle of the pack. Sustaining a drive that consists of solely 3-5 yard plays just isn’t going to work. Top line stats look fine. 400 yards of offense, close to 50% on third downs, and nearly 30 first downs. Everyone loves those numbers, but it should mean more than 37 points. Hey at least special teams got some points, more efficient than our offense too. Buckly up for Virginia Tech, it could get ugly again.

item.title: This is the beginning of the end for this iteration of the Colts
item.description: INDIANAPOLIS, INDIANA - OCTOBER 18: Head coach Shane Steichen of the Indianapolis Colts looks on during the fourth quarter against the Tennessee Titans at Lucas Oil Stadium on October 18, 2026 in Indianapolis, Indiana. (Photo by Justin Casterline/Getty Images) | Getty Images The Chris Ballard era is over. Shane Steichen at the helm is no more. Daniel Jones as the quarterback for the Indianapolis Colts is on incredibly thin ice. Losing to the Tennessee Titans sure feels like the straw that will break the camel’s back. For a season in which the motto is “Find a Way”, the only thing this organization needs to find a way to do is to push the reset button. It’s been six weeks, so saying it’s all over is tough. A lot can change with two-thirds of the season left. The biggest issue is the here and now. After falling to the winless Titans at home, the Colts find themselves at 2-4. That is the now. The immediate future is bleak as well. Not to say that the Colts can’t win but the undefeated Vikings and the Jaguars, both on the road, lie ahead. Ask yourself if you see those games going well. Time is up. The beginning part of this season was do or die. Finding a way didn’t mean find a way to lose to the worst team in football. Props to the Colts for finding creative ways to lose, but that isn’t what Carlie Irsay-Gordon had in mind. Ballard’s seat is so hot that it should have already melted. Steichen hasn’t shown enough to make it out of this. The failures are evident and felt by the players too. This is rock bottom and change is needed. Patience is a virtue, but it isn’t a requirement in the NFL. The Irsays have shown enough over the years to this staff and personnel. Daniel Jones doesn’t have the juice. Shane Steichen has shown an inability to win. Chris Ballard has failed to put a good product on the field 90% of the time. We knew this was coming. Sunday’s disaster was the gust of wind that will topple this house of cards.

item.title: NBA Restricts Sportsbook Bets — Will Kalshi and Polymarket Follow?
item.description: The NBA’s new sportsbook restrictions highlight questions over whether prediction exchanges will adopt equivalent betting limits. Key Takeaways The NBA is restricting several betting markets offered by its sportsbook partners. Its sportsbook agreements do not give it equivalent control over Kalshi and Polymarket. The changes raise questions about the consistency of integrity protections across competing platforms. The NBA is tightening control over bets that could reward manipulated performances, but its authority does not extend to every platform where fans trade on basketball outcomes. As prediction exchanges fall outside the NBA’s agreements, this raises the question of whether they will adopt the same limits as concern over insider trading grows. Which Bets Is the NBA Restricting? According to InGame, which cites a league letter obtained by ESPN, the restrictions include: Parlays combining multiple statistical unders for the same player. Wagers on the winner of the opening tip. Certain negative outcomes involving individual plays, including missed shots. Unders on players expected to play fewer than 12 minutes. An under wins when a player finishes below a specified statistical threshold. Combining several unders can allow a bettor to profit across multiple categories if that player makes an unexpectedly early exit. DraftKings said the changes partly formalize limits it already applies. “The NBA’s guidance formalizes many of the market restrictions already reflected in DraftKings Sportsbook’s practices,” a spokesperson told InGame. Why Player Unders Have Become an Integrity Concern The restrictions address a vulnerability first exposed by the Jontay Porter scandal; advance knowledge of limited playing time can affect several wagers simultaneously. The NBA banned Porter in April 2024 after finding that he had wagered on NBA games and even limited his participation for betting-related reasons. For example, an early departure off the court can reduce a player’s opportunities to score and assist. A bettor who therefore knows about a planned departure beforehand could hold an advantage across those two markets. What Are Kalshi and Polymarket Offering? Public pages reviewed by CCN on Oct. 19 show that both exchanges offer NBA trading. Kalshi’s basketball hub lists individual matchups alongside spread and total markets. Polymarket US also lists upcoming NBA games, while its separate international platform carries markets including the 2027 championship. As CCN previously explained , sports prediction contracts have become a focal point of the dispute between federal derivatives regulation and state gambling oversight. An exchange contract and a sportsbook wager can expose users to the same sporting outcome, yet operate under different regulatory structures. A future agreement with a prediction exchange could give the league greater contractual influence over that operator’s products. Legal Sports Report reported that the NBA had not announced such a
item.content:encoded: The NBA’s new sportsbook restrictions highlight questions over whether prediction exchanges will adopt equivalent betting limits. Key Takeaways The NBA is restricting several betting markets offered by its sportsbook partners. Its sportsbook agreements do not give it equivalent control over Kalshi and Polymarket. The changes raise questions about the consistency of integrity protections across competing platforms. The NBA is tightening control over bets that could reward manipulated performances, but its authority does not extend to every platform where fans trade on basketball outcomes. As prediction exchanges fall outside the NBA’s agreements, this raises the question of whether they will adopt the same limits as concern over insider trading grows. Which Bets Is the NBA Restricting? According to InGame, which cites a league letter obtained by ESPN, the restrictions include: Parlays combining multiple statistical unders for the same player. Wagers on the winner of the opening tip. Certain negative outcomes involving individual plays, including missed shots. Unders on players expected to play fewer than 12 minutes. An under wins when a player finishes below a specified statistical threshold. Combining several unders can allow a bettor to profit across multiple categories if that player makes an unexpectedly early exit. DraftKings said the changes partly formalize limits it already applies. “The NBA’s guidance formalizes many of the market restrictions already reflected in DraftKings Sportsbook’s practices,” a spokesperson told InGame. Why Player Unders Have Become an Integrity Concern The restrictions address a vulnerability first exposed by the Jontay Porter scandal; advance knowledge of limited playing time can affect several wagers simultaneously. The NBA banned Porter in April 2024 after finding that he had wagered on NBA games and even limited his participation for betting-related reasons. For example, an early departure off the court can reduce a player’s opportunities to score and assist. A bettor who therefore knows about a planned departure beforehand could hold an advantage across those two markets. What Are Kalshi and Polymarket Offering? Public pages reviewed by CCN on Oct. 19 show that both exchanges offer NBA trading. Kalshi’s basketball hub lists individual matchups alongside spread and total markets. Polymarket US also lists upcoming NBA games, while its separate international platform carries markets including the 2027 championship. As CCN previously explained , sports prediction contracts have become a focal point of the dispute between federal derivatives regulation and state gambling oversight. An exchange contract and a sportsbook wager can expose users to the same sporting outcome, yet operate under different regulatory structures. A future agreement with a prediction exchange could give the league greater contractual influence over that operator’s products. Legal Sports Report reported that the NBA had not announced such a partnership when the restrictions emerged. Prediction Markets Face Growing Scrutiny The NBA’s restrictions arrive amid broader questions about whether prediction markets adequately protect users against insider trading and manipulation. In May, House Oversight Committee Chairman James Comer launched an investigation into Kalshi and Polymarket, requesting information about identity checks and how the platforms detect suspicious trading. “As online prediction platforms grow and become more mainstream, some bad actors have exploited the platforms to make thousands of dollars by placing bets based on nonpublic information,” said Chairman Comer. “Americans deserve to know that these platforms are taking steps to prevent insider trading,” he added. Concerns have already led to concrete disciplinary action. In February, the Commodity Futures Trading Commission issued an advisory following two Kalshi cases involving misuse of nonpublic information and fraud. “In May 2025, social media posts contained videos that appeared to show a political candidate trading on his own candidacy on Kalshi,” the CFTC wrote in its report. Meanwhile, in August and September 2025, “an individual traded a prediction market related to a YouTube channel while having an employment relationship… with the subject of the contract.” Critics have also challenged whether sports contracts allow operators to bypass protections required of state-licensed gambling businesses. As CCN previously reported , state regulators and tribal groups have contested the industry’s reliance on federal derivatives oversight, arguing that sports contracts amount to gambling subject to additional restrictions. The post NBA Restricts Sportsbook Bets — Will Kalshi and Polymarket Follow? appeared first on ccn.com .

item.title: Who plays on 'Monday Night Football' tonight? Time, TV channel, schedule, live stream for NFL Week 6 game
item.description: Who plays on 'Monday Night Football' tonight? Time, TV channel, schedule, live stream for NFL Week 6 game originally appeared on The Sporting News . Add The Sporting News as a Preferred Source by clicking here . The story for the 49ers entering the season was injuries, right down to head coach Kyle Shanahan. The story since the start of the season has been success. While injuries certainly have been a factor for the 'Niners, from Nick Bosa to De'Zhaun Stribling and Deebo Samuel, Shanahan's group has found a way to thrive in spite of them. After the 49ers won in Seattle in Week 5, the NFC West could just be a race for second behind San Francisco. On the other side of the country, the Commanders have managed just one win in five games. That doesn't mean they have four losses, though. Washington settled for a tie in Week 5, after a disastrous final sequence that largely remains unexplained. Coach Dan Quinn said after the game that it felt like a loss, and it's hard to argue with that. Going on the road and handing the 49ers their first loss would unquestionably be a win, though. The upset-minded Commanders are hoping to channel last weekend's frustration and leave the west coast feeling like they can compete in a wide-open NFC East race. With that, here's what you need to know to watch "Monday Night Football" in Week 6. Who plays on Monday Night Football tonight? Matchup: Commanders vs. 49ers Location: Levi's Stadium, Santa Clara, CA "Monday Night Football" is headed to the Bay Area in Week 6, with the undefeated 49ers hosting the Commanders. What time is the NFL game on tonight? Date: Monday, Oct. 19 Time: 8:15 p.m. ET | 5:15 p.m. PT Commanders vs. 49ers will kick off at 8:15 p.m. ET (5:15 p.m. local time) from Levi's Stadium on Monday night. What channel is Monday Night Football on tonight? TV channel: ESPN Live stream: DIRECTV | ESPN | Fubo "Monday Night Football" will be simulcast live on ESPN, with Joe Buck (play-by-play) in the booth alongside Troy Aikman (analyst) from SoFi Stadium. item.title: Why do Man City fans have inflatable bananas? Explaining retro fan craze in defiance of Premier League guilty verdict
item.description: Why do Man City fans have inflatable bananas? Explaining retro fan craze in defiance of Premier League guilty verdict originally appeared on The Sporting News . Add The Sporting News as a Preferred Source by clicking here . So much of the build-up to the October 11 Premier League showdown between Liverpool and Manchester City was dominated by discussions about the atmosphere. The Anfield crowd was anticipated to bring an extreme state of vitriolic hostility and fury to the occasion, as City stepped out for the first time since the Premier League found them guilty of all charges related to serious financial breaches of competition rules between 2009/10 and 2017/18. Just after the period that was examined by an independent commission and resulted in a shockingly damning verdict – where City were found to have concocted "sham" sponsorship agreements with companies from Abu Dhabi and put forward witnesses believed to have lied – Jurgen Klopp's Liverpool went blow-for-blow with Pep Guardiola's City in thrilling title races in 2018/19 and 2021/22. Twice Liverpool racked up in excess of 90 points; twice they lost the league by a point. Andoni Iraola and Enzo Maresca led the two sides, and few of the main characters from those incredible battles remained. Enmity on the Kop, understandably, did. MORE: Jurgen Klopp lands on deeper Pep Guardiola truth amid 115 charges "Absolutely, [the City players] can face the pressure," a relaxed Enzo Maresca said at his pre-match press conference. "We have players who have experience of similar situations. Enzo Fernandez played in Argentina. In Argentina, almost every game is like you go to Anfield." The response from City's travelling supporters, viewed by millions of television viewers across the world as they raucously celebrated a 3-0 win , invited puzzlement. Tucked away in the left-hand corner of the Anfield Road End, the Mancunian contingent brandished dozens upon dozens of large inflatable bananas. It was the same story at City's first Premier League home game after the verdict — a 3-2 win over Ipswich Town — as thousands of inflatable bananas dotted a capacity 60,000 attendance at the Etihad Stadium. Phil Foden arrived for his post-match interview with an inflatable banana 🍌 https://t.co/15brfnndUb — Match of the Day (@BBCMOTD) October 17, 2026 Why do Man City fans have inflatable bananas? The origin story of Manchester City's near 40-year association with inflatable bananas goes back to the 1987/88 season, the club's first back in Division Two after being relegated from Division One the previous year. Like a lot of the best stories, it features some palpably rubbish wordplay. "It started because of [former City forward] Imre Varadi," said Dante Friend of 1894 , the City fan group who have distributed upwards of 1,000 inflatable bananas among supporters traveling to Anfield. item.content:encoded: Why do Man City fans have inflatable bananas? Explaining retro fan craze in defiance of Premier League guilty verdict originally appeared on The Sporting News . Add The Sporting News as a Preferred Source by clicking here . So much of the build-up to the October 11 Premier League showdown between Liverpool and Manchester City was dominated by discussions about the atmosphere. The Anfield crowd was anticipated to bring an extreme state of vitriolic hostility and fury to the occasion, as City stepped out for the first time since the Premier League found them guilty of all charges related to serious financial breaches of competition rules between 2009/10 and 2017/18. Just after the period that was examined by an independent commission and resulted in a shockingly damning verdict – where City were found to have concocted "sham" sponsorship agreements with companies from Abu Dhabi and put forward witnesses believed to have lied – Jurgen Klopp's Liverpool went blow-for-blow with Pep Guardiola's City in thrilling title races in 2018/19 and 2021/22. Twice Liverpool racked up in excess of 90 points; twice they lost the league by a point. Andoni Iraola and Enzo Maresca led the two sides, and few of the main characters from those incredible battles remained. Enmity on the Kop, understandably, did. MORE: Jurgen Klopp lands on deeper Pep Guardiola truth amid 115 charges "Absolutely, [the City players] can face the pressure," a relaxed Enzo Maresca said at his pre-match press conference. "We have players who have experience of similar situations. Enzo Fernandez played in Argentina. In Argentina, almost every game is like you go to Anfield." The response from City's travelling supporters, viewed by millions of television viewers across the world as they raucously celebrated a 3-0 win , invited puzzlement. Tucked away in the left-hand corner of the Anfield Road End, the Mancunian contingent brandished dozens upon dozens of large inflatable bananas. It was the same story at City's first Premier League home game after the verdict — a 3-2 win over Ipswich Town — as thousands of inflatable bananas dotted a capacity 60,000 attendance at the Etihad Stadium. Phil Foden arrived for his post-match interview with an inflatable banana 🍌 https://t.co/15brfnndUb — Match of the Day (@BBCMOTD) October 17, 2026 Why do Man City fans have inflatable bananas? The origin story of Manchester City's near 40-year association with inflatable bananas goes back to the 1987/88 season, the club's first back in Division Two after being relegated from Division One the previous year. Like a lot of the best stories, it features some palpably rubbish wordplay. "It started because of [former City forward] Imre Varadi," said Dante Friend of 1894 , the City fan group who have distributed upwards of 1,000 inflatable bananas among supporters traveling to Anfield. "It was just one guy at the game who referred to him as "Imre Banana". A guy called Frank Newton took an inflatable banana to the next game, and then everyone started doing it." There were all sorts of other inflatables, from paddling pools to fried eggs and Frankenstein's monster, but it was the bananas that endured. Sometimes in this job, you find yourself writing the strangest sentences imaginable. Varadi enjoyed a nomadic career in English football, representing City, Everton , Sheffield Wednesday and Leeds among many others. He scored 31 times in 81 appearances for City across all competitions, a very solid return at a time when the club was not at its best on the field. His wider legacy has nothing to do with any of those goals, and it's one he continues to embrace. "The bananas are taking over Anfield," Varadi posted on X (account handle: @imre_banana ) on the morning of the Liverpool match. "City fans are ready to party at Liverpool." 🍌🍌 The bananas are taking over Anfield! ⚽ Great to see our inflatable bananas getting a mention on Sky Sports this morning and making the back page of the Daily Star! 📰 City fans are ready to party at Liverpool! 💙🍌 #MCFC — Imre Varadi (@imre_banana) October 11, 2026 Manchester also knew how to throw a party during the mid-to-late 1980s, as the acid house music scene that in turn spawned the 'Madchester' craze thrived. The famous Hacienda nightclub was the high church of the movement – a temple of optimism and love via chemical refreshment, that stood at odds with the often desolate state of hooligan-addled English football as Margaret Thatcher's conservative government oversaw a period of post-industrial decline in many of the country's biggest cities. "The reason some people were doing it as a joke was because they were going out clubbing on a Friday night to places like the Hacienda and the Brickhouse and were absolutely off their heads on ecstasy, then falling into the match the next afternoon," Friend recalled. "They weren't interested in fighting. Most of the fans were having a laugh. We were s—, we were in Division Two. I think, every now and then, when it's fan-led and not club-led, [bringing back the bananas] can be really good. It'll be a laugh." Getty Images And that's the spirit being tapped into as Manchester City, to many, embark on a new chapter as pariahs of English football. The spirit of a club founded in 1894 that won its first trophy in 1904 and has seen all sorts of majestically brilliant, perplexingly bad and mind-numbingly average iterations throughout this long history. Their trajectory was changed beyond all recognition by Sheikh Mansour's 2008 takeover. Pending an appeal, the wrongdoing of the Abu Dhabi royal's trusted executives will change that path once again. But nothing is permanent. Manchester City were here before their current ownership, and it would be a travesty for generation upon generation of fans if they weren't after them. MORE: Man City owners' fraud punishes players and fans more than Premier League ever can When City struggled in the 1980s and again, even more severely in the 1990s, inflatable bananas were there to celebrate every promotion back to the big time. They've featured in every pitch invasion after every Premier League success at the Etihad Stadium. Whatever those titles mean now, they promoted grown adults to wave ridiculous, oversized novelty fruit above their heads. Because sport is brilliant like that. The reborn banana craze is a show of defiance from City fans, who before the days of billion-dollar spending counted gallows humour and sarcasm as their most potent weapons. They're not scared to go back there if they have to. Don't threaten them with a good time. "The message is obviously defiance," Friend added. "We don't give a f— who the owners are, we are the club. The fans are the club."

item.title: ‘League in Shambles,’ ‘Huge Signing’ – Jalen Williams, NBA Fans React to Thunder’s ‘Ridiculous’ $139 Million Decision on Cason Wallace
item.description: Cason Wallace and the OKC Thunder have agreed to a five-year, $139 million contract extension. Here's what the NBA world has to say. Right before the 2026-27 NBA season officially tips off, the Oklahoma City Thunder and Cason Wallace agreed to a five-year, $139 million contract extension. A massive deal, the rookie-scale contract will ensure Wallace remains with the team until the 2031-32 season. Confirmed by agents Jeff Schwartz, Max Lipsett, and Marcus Monk of Excel Sports Management, the new contract generated a lot of buzz, especially as many fans considered the real implications of such a commitment from the Thunder and Wallace. Jalen Williams, NBA Fans Weigh In on Thunder-Cason Wallace Deal A first-round pick in 2023, Wallace has steadily made his way up the NBA ladder over the past few seasons. The Thunder, looking to reclaim success, are ensuring every player on their roster is accounted for. Of course, signing Wallace in 2026 was an important move, especially as they looked to avoid lucrative offers if he became a restricted free agent next year. “Oklahoma City Thunder All-Defensive guard Cason Wallace has agreed to a five-year, $139 million rookie-scale contract extension, agents Jeff Schwartz, Max Lipsett and Marcus Monk of Excel Sports Management tell ESPN,” Shams Charania reported on Sunday night. Fans, however, had varying opinions on the five-year deal. Journalist Rylan Stiles, who covers OKC, was quick to react as he wrote : “Huge signing for Oklahoma City.” While many agreed with Stiles, some fans believed the signing was a big mistake, with one claiming it reflected on the NBA itself. This includes teams signing young players to large contracts they don’t need to lock down just yet. “… 😂 28 million is ridiculous,” the user wrote . “League in shambles 😭😭😭,” another hoops fan said . Of course, Wallace’s teammate Jalen Williams was happy and expressed his reaction with a three-word message. “Right on time,” Williams posted on Instagram. Some users agreed with both sides, pointing out that while Wallace is a good player, a contract this big is an overpay. “Cason Wallace is a good player. This is an overpay. 2 things can be true,” the fan stated on X. ESPN insider Bobby Marks explained the deal and Thunder’s position further as he wrote : “And yes, OKC is a projected second apron team (right now they are $26M over) and face a tax bill that could exceed $200M. But as the apron rules teach us, the restrictions apply to adding to your roster in free agency and trades, not with retaining your own players.” “Great deal for Wallace and the Thunder,” OKC beat writer Brandon Rahbar added . This also holds true after impressive production last season. Wallace averaged 8.6 points, 3.1 rebounds, and 2.6 assists per game while shooting 43.2% from the field and 35.1% from the three-point range. He also earned an All-Defensive Second Team honor with 150 steals. Back in September, Thunder president Sam Presti directly addressed Wallace’s role on th

Journalist Rylan Stiles, who covers OKC, was quick to react as he wrote : “Huge signing for Oklahoma City.” While many agreed with Stiles, some fans believed the signing was a big mistake, with one claiming it reflected on the NBA itself. This includes teams signing young players to large contracts they don’t need to lock down just yet. “… 😂 28 million is ridiculous,” the user wrote . “League in shambles 😭😭😭,” another hoops fan said . Of course, Wallace’s teammate Jalen Williams was happy and expressed his reaction with a three-word message. “Right on time,” Williams posted on Instagram. Some users agreed with both sides, pointing out that while Wallace is a good player, a contract this big is an overpay. “Cason Wallace is a good player. This is an overpay. 2 things can be true,” the fan stated on X. ESPN insider Bobby Marks explained the deal and Thunder’s position further as he wrote : “And yes, OKC is a projected second apron team (right now they are $26M over) and face a tax bill that could exceed $200M. But as the apron rules teach us, the restrictions apply to adding to your roster in free agency and trades, not with retaining your own players.” “Great deal for Wallace and the Thunder,” OKC beat writer Brandon Rahbar added . This also holds true after impressive production last season. Wallace averaged 8.6 points, 3.1 rebounds, and 2.6 assists per game while shooting 43.2% from the field and 35.1% from the three-point range. He also earned an All-Defensive Second Team honor with 150 steals. Back in September, Thunder president Sam Presti directly addressed Wallace’s role on the team and even spoke about OKC trading Lu Dort to the Atlanta Hawks, which will in turn grow Wallace’s role with the team. DON’T MISS: ‘It Doesn’t Count’ — Klay Thompson Gets Defiant As Nightmarish Preseason Fuels Fears of Heat Sharpshooter’s Further Decline “I think the greatest sign of respect we could have shown Cason is moving Lu in that trade,” Sam Presti explained . “We potentially could have looked at a series of other options, but it’s a bit of a gesture to him to say, ‘We think you can have a great role on this team. We believe in you as a player. And we’re hopeful that (contract extension talks) can work out.’” The Thunder have also generally relied on depth, and the 22-year-old’s presence will only add to their arsenal as they open their 2026-27 season against the San Antonio Spurs on Tuesday, October 20. This article originally appeared on Pro Football Network .

item.title: Ballon d’Or odds: Kane favourite ahead of Yamal, Rodri and Mbappe
item.description: The Ballon d’Or may be heading to Germany, with Harry Kane back as the favourite to lift the trophy on betting sites . After scoring 73 goals in 65 appearances for club and country, including six goals for England at the World Cup, Kane has been reinstalled as the favourite to clinch world football’s top individual honour. The race previously shifted in favour of Barcelona’s Lamine Yamal, with the teenager going odds-on with the bookies after he played his part in Spain becoming the world champions for only the second time. But ahead of the glittering ceremony on October 26, the England skipper could be about to add even more honours to his already impressive CV. 2026 Ballon d’Or odds Were Kane to win the Ballon d’Or, he’d be only the fifth Englishman to clinch the prize and the first since Michael Owen in 2001. He was installed as the early frontrunner by football betting sites after a storming 2025/26 campaign. Kane’s form since joining the German giants has been incredible, with 152 goals in 154 appearances as he helped his side to two Bundesliga titles, the Franz Beckenbauer Supercup and the German Cup. On a personal level, he has been the Bundesliga’s top scorer for each of his three seasons in Germany, including last season when he finished with 36 goals in 31 league appearances. His form for England has been equally impressive this year too, with the ex-Tottenham forward taking his tally to 91 goals and counting for the national side, playing a starring role in their run to the World Cup semi-finals. Kylian Mbappe also tasted disappointment at the World Cup as France finished fourth, but he won the Golden Boot for the second tournament in a row after scoring 10 and assisting a further four goals. He scored twice in the third-placed play-off defeat to England to move two clear of Messi in the scoring charts, finishing as top scorer. The Real Madrid striker was in excellent scoring form for his club last season, too, finishing the campaign with 58 goals in 60 appearances for club and country, including 15 in the Champions League, to top the scoring charts. Real finished trophyless, though, after being pipped to the La Liga title by Barcelona and beaten by the same opponents in the Spanish Super Cup final. The 27-year-old’s best finish in the Ballon d’Or is third back in 2023 when Lionel Messi won for the eighth time, and the odds suggest he won’t better that this time around. Messi odds for Ballon d’Or Messi retains an outside chance of winning what would be an extraordinary ninth Ballon d’Or title. item.title: England manager Wiegman signs contract extension
item.description: Sarina Wiegman has been in charge of England for more than five years [Getty Images] England manager Sarina Wiegman has signed a two-year contract extension with the Lionesses. The 56-year-old's previous deal was due to expire after next summer's World Cup, but her new contract will run until the end of Euro 2029. Dutchwoman Wiegman guided England to their second straight European Championship title with victory over Spain in the Euro 2025 final. The victory meant the Lionesses became the first England team - women's or men's - to win a major trophy on foreign soil. "I am so happy to be able to carry on with this squad and cannot think of a better job in football," said Wiegman. "Working for a world-class organisation like The FA, and alongside so many people dedicated to winning England teams and the growth of our game, excites me every day." England thrashed Greece 8-1 on aggregate last week to qualify for round two of the World Cup play-offs, where they will face Ukraine. Should the Lionesses win that two-legged tie, they will qualify for next summer's World Cup in Brazil. "My main concern right now is absolutely the World Cup, and helping this squad realise their potential in the years to come," Wiegman added. "We have an important job to do to confirm our place in Brazil, and hopefully we can do that and give the country another special summer to remember next year." Wiegman replaced Phil Neville as England manager in September 2021, guiding the Lionesses to their first piece of major silverware at Euro 2022 when they beat Germany 2-1 in the final at Wembley. England then reached the World Cup final in Australia in 2023, only to lose 1-0 to Spain. By reaching the 2025 Euros final, Wiegman became the first women's or men's manager to reach five consecutive major international finals after leading the Netherlands to the Euro 2017 title and runners-up at the 2019 World Cup. England's Euro 2025 victory meant Wiegman became just the second manager after Germany's Christina Theune to win three successive European Championships. FA chief Mark Bullingham described Wiegman as an "incredible coach with an unparalleled record in major tournaments". "While we will all remember the trophies and thrilling moments she has given us, I know she is only looking forward," Bullingham added. "There is no one better to lead the Lionesses into the next two tournaments. "Sarina's impact on English football has been immense, and she continues to inspire so many throughout the game. We have so much more to do in the women's game and she will be instrumental in helping us to achieve that." Does Scott's Disney+ exit unmask wider issue in coverage of women's game? Contract a welcome surprise - analysis The FA and England fans alike will be delighted that the 'Wiegman era' is set to continue beyond the 2027 World Cup. Contract a welcome surprise - analysis The FA and England fans alike will be delighted that the 'Wiegman era' is set to continue beyond the 2027 World Cup. Having led the Lionesses to back-to-back European titles and the 2023 World Cup final, many expected Wiegman to leave after next summer's tournament in Brazil in search of a new challenge. Instead, her commitment to stay until 2029 underlines the strength of her relationship with the FA and her team. While today's announcement may have surprised some, the timing now allows Wiegman and the players to focus fully on World Cup qualification, without the distraction of a looming succession plan. Widely regarded as one of the game's greatest-ever coaches, Wiegman has already achieved what few can match. But even after three consecutive Euros, this contract extension proves she still has an appetite for more as she chases an elusive World Cup title. Head here to get involved

item.title: ‘Dak Prescott Has To Play Better’ — Robert Griffin III Argues Cowboys QB Looked Like a ‘Human Punching Bag’ In Primetime Loss to Packers
item.description: ‘Dak Prescott Looked Like a Human Punching Bag’ — Robert Griffin III, Ex-NFL Safety Raise Red Flags After Cowboys’ Embarrassing Primetime Loss to Packers Dak Prescott and the Dallas Cowboys suffered a 23-13 loss to the Green Bay Packers on Sunday Night Football, extending their losing streak to two games and dropping the team to 2-4. The ugly run has been a major blow for the Cowboys, who entered the season with playoff aspirations. Their disappointing performance against Green Bay also drew reactions from several former NFL stars, including Robert Griffin III. Dak Prescott and Cowboys Face Growing Concerns as Robert Griffin III Highlights Major Issues Prescott faced constant pressure from the Packers’ defense on Sunday, throwing two interceptions in the first half. He completed 63% of his passes for 258 yards and one touchdown, along with two interceptions. Prescott currently ranks No. 15 in PFN’s QB Impact Metric with a 76.7 grade. Following Dallas’ loss, Griffin shared three major takeaways from the game, with his first focusing on Prescott and the Cowboys’ offensive line. “Dak Prescott has to play better, and the offensive line has to play better so he isn’t a human punching bag in the pocket,” Griffin wrote . “Because the defense’s reputation cannot keep giving the offense a free pass. Dallas was using star WRs CeeDee Lamb and George Pickens like supporting actors in the first half. “At halftime, Lamb had two catches for 22 yards on six targets, and Pickens had one catch for 16 yards on one target. Three catches for 38 yards isn’t winning football. They need more quality targets and schemes that generate easy completions for them and Dak Prescott.” PREDICT THE NFL SEASON: PFN’s Free NFL Playoff Predictor Former NFL safety Justin Simmons also weighed in on Dallas’ offensive struggles, expressing confidence in the team’s offensive line and its talented receiving duo. Simmons said that, outside the Cincinnati Bengals’ pairing of Ja’Marr Chase and Tee Higgins, Lamb and Pickens could arguably form the best wide receiver duo in the league. However, Simmons questioned why the Cowboys were not doing more to get the ball into their hands. DIVE IN: PFN’s Free NFL HQ — Team and Player Stats, Info, and More “I’m more concerned about creativity. I’m more concerned about the play calling itself,” Simmons said. “As great as Dak is, every quarterback needs to get into a rhythm to start the football game, and we’re not seeing that.. I feel like we’re asking Dak to step onto the football field and take all the burden of being one of the best quarterbacks in the league and to decipher every single play. “Are they doing this? So you got to be able to run the ball, and you got to be able to set him up with easy, quick throws to these star receivers, so that they can get running.” Dallas’ defensive struggles were equally concerning in the first half, as the Cowboys had virtually no answer for Green Bay on third down, allowing the Packers to convert 9 of 10 attempts through the opening two quarters. Green Bay entered the game ranked last in the NFL in third-down conversion percentage at just 27.6%. “Dallas is giving struggling offenses a place to get healthy and confident,” Griffin said. “Getting to third down means nothing if you can’t get off the field.” However, as Griffin noted, the Cowboys’ defense showed improvement after halftime and allowed the offense to make a comeback, only for the offense to waste that chance. Dallas limited Green Bay to just two conversions on eight third-down attempts in the second half while allowing only six points after the break. The Cowboys will now turn their attention to the game against the Philadelphia Eagles on October 26, on Monday Night Football. This article originally appeared on Pro Football Network .

item.title: Sarina Wiegman signs two-year contract extension as England head coach
item.description: FILE PHOTO - England's coach Sarina Wiegman speaks during a press conference for the England women's national soccer team at Wembley Stadium, ahead of Sunday's UEFA Women's EURO 2022 final match against Germany. (is associated with: «Sarina Wiegman signs two-year contract extension as England head coach») Sebastian Gollnow/dpa England head coach Sarina Wiegman will lead the Lionesses through to the end of the 2029 European Women’s Championship after signing a two-year contract extension. Wiegman has guided England to triumphs at the 2022 and 2025 Euros, as well as a first World Cup final in 2023, since taking charge in September 2021. The 56-year-old Dutchwoman, a five-time FIFA Best winner, has reached five successive major tournament finals, also winning the 2017 Euros with her native Netherlands. Wiegman said: “I am so happy to be able to carry on with this squad and cannot think of a better job in football. “Working for a world-class organization, and alongside so many people dedicated to winning England teams and the growth of our game, excites me every day. “I am grateful to Mark Bullingham, Debbie Hewitt and the FA board for the incredible way they have backed me, my coaches and support team and, of course, the players. “I am honoured by their trust, which I never take for granted, and want to keep this great partnership going. I have such a strong desire to see what more we can achieve together with our amazing fans. “I also want to keep supporting the wonderful collaborative work being led by the FA across the women’s game, particularly in developing young players and coaches. “Of course, anyone who knows me will understand that my main concern right now is absolutely the World Cup, and helping this squad realize their potential in the years to come. “We have an important job to do to confirm our place in Brazil, and hopefully we can do that and give the country another special summer to remember next year.” England, who were beaten by Spain at the 2023 World Cup final in Australia, will face Ukraine over a two-legged play-off in November and December for a place in next year’s tournament in Brazil. Wiegman’s new deal will also encompass the 2027 Nations League, which serves as a qualifying tournament for the Los Angeles 2028 Olympics. It is the second time she has prolonged her stay in England, having first agreed a contract extension in January 2024. FA CEO Mark Bullingham said: “Sarina is an incredible coach with an unparalleled record in major tournaments and I am so happy to continue to work with her for the next Euro cycle. “While we will all remember the trophies and thrilling moments she has given us, I know she is only looking forward. There is no one better to lead the Lionesses into the next two tournaments. “Sarina’s impact on English football has been immense, and she continues to inspire so many throughout the game. We have so much more to do in the women’s game and she will be instrumental in helping us to achieve that.”

item.title: (Video): Patient rotated PSG score 3 goals late to beat talented Strasbourg
item.description: (Video): Patient rotated PSG score 3 goals late to beat talented Strasbourg A rotated PSG side left it late to come back against Strasbourg in an exciting game on Saturday evening in Alsace. If you enjoy PSG Talk coverage and want to see more of it, add us as a preferred source on Google to make us a favourite and see more of our content. PSG came back with a late triple to beat Strasbourg away in Alsace on Saturday afternoon. Gio Reyna fired a shot at the near post which got a crucial touch off a defender to take it past Matvey Safonov in the PSG goal. The game could have changed when Strasbourg had their big chance after the break. Conrad Harder got up well and put in a brilliant header which Safonov saved, and Reyna lashed the follow up over. Harder had another go with 66 minutes on the clock from a tight angle, but the Russian stopper denied him again to keep it at 1-0. Patient PSG win it late Ousmane Dembele celebrates against Strasbourg. Not long after that, everything changed. PSG got lucky with a penalty from nowhere which Ousmane Dembele missed, but with 76 minutes on the clock he swung in a great cross which Ilya Zabarnyi turned in. With 85 minutes played, Dembele got his foot to a loose ball for his first Ligue 1 goal of the season with a nice strike from range. PSG wrapped up the win when Ferran Torres assisted Desire Doue in injury time. You can see the highlights in the clip embedded here: In other news… Luis Enrique changed his team heavily for the game, and it almost backfired. But in the end PSG get the points and a rest for some key starters. Marquinhos was not in the team to face Strasbourg as Luis Enrique continued his strict rotation policy. Maghnes Akliouche got the start – and his manager is delighted with his progress.

item.title: Museum exhibit reveals the intricate workings of a knackered Dell
item.description: Today's entry in the catalog of bork comes from Coventry's Herbert Art Gallery & Museum, where an information terminal is showing more about the hardware behind the scenes than the objects on display. Register reader Jeffrey Borinsky spotted the panel, which should have demonstrated a Jacquard loom in action but was instead displaying a warning about its host PC's failing battery. The Jacquard loom was a clever device dating back to the dawn of the 19th century. It used punched cards to control a loom's weaving patterns. The result was complicated and repeatable textile designs that reduced the need for skilled humans. Register readers of a certain age are doubtless nodding sagely at the mention of punched cards, which would go on to become foundational in the world of computing. Borinsky reported that several screens at the museum were in distress. Ribbon weaving was Coventry's main industry from the early 1700s until the 1860s, so a demonstration of Jacquard weaving fits right in, even if the bleating about the BIOS battery was probably not what Joseph Jacquard had in mind. The device running behind the scenes is a Dell OptiPlex 755, likely from around 2007. Not quite centuries old like a Jacquard loom, but certainly getting on a bit in the IT world. The first iPhone arrived in 2007, and a PC of a similar vintage likely shipped with Windows XP or Windows Vista. The CMOS battery is on the way out. Dell specifies a CR2032 coin cell, so replacement should be straightforward after disconnecting the power and taking anti-static precautions. Rather less traumatic than the head-in-hands moment when a retro enthusiast discovers a leaking battery has eaten through delicate circuit traces. A fresh battery and restored BIOS settings should be enough to get the loom demonstration weaving again. Given how important punched cards became in the history of computing, we'd recommend visiting anywhere that shows how a Jacquard loom operated. At least it didn't need a battery-backed BIOS to do its thing. ®

item.title: Massive clean-up operation sweeps across France after protests
item.description: A massive clean-up operation was under way across France on Monday, from Lille in the north to Marseille in the south and from Strasbourg in the east to Bordeaux in the southwest, following nationwide demonstrations last weekend. The protests over high prices and declining public services were followed by widespread looting and damage to shops, with thousands arrested. FRANCE 24's Luke Shrago reports from central Paris.

item.title: Gunmen shoot Bollywood actor Tiger Shroff in Mumbai, three suspects held
item.description: Indian actor Tiger Shroff was shot at in Mumbai on Sunday, police said, adding that three suspects have been detained. Shooters opened fire at the 36-year-old actor as he was leaving a private event in the city’s upscale Juhu area on Sunday evening, according to Police official Mohit Garg. Aside from being India’s financial capital, Mumbai is also the heart of Bollywood, the country’s Hindi-language film industry. “Tiger Shroff is safe and Mumbai police has deployed different teams to investigate further,” Garg told reporters. Two people were injured in the incident, including the actor’s driver, though Shroff did not sustain gunshot wounds, police said. Three suspects have been rounded up in Rajasthan, another Indian state. “Preliminary questioning revealed that two of them have one case each against them, one related to theft and the other under the Arms Act,” police official Tejaswani Gautam told reporters. Police have yet to establish a motive for the shooting. Shroff is known for action films including the “Baaghi” franchise and “War”. AFP The post Gunmen shoot Bollywood actor Tiger Shroff in Mumbai, three suspects held appeared first on Vanguard News .

item.title: French interior minister admits police 'lost control' of protests
item.description: France's Interior Minister Laurent Nunez admitted Monday that the police "lost control" in some cities during violent protests that erupted in cities across the country at the weekend. He said there had been a "lack of anticipation" in preparations and that he had tendered his resignation to President Emmanuel Macron "because I felt responsible for everything that happened." Macron did not accept his resignation.

item.title: Nigerian newspapers review: Presidency, Makinde in verbal war over N250bn NLNG dividend
item.description: In today’s Nigerian newspapers review programme, Today in the News, Vanguard leads with the Presidency dismissing Oyo State Governor Seyi Makinde’s latest claim that the federal government was withholding N250 billion in NLNG dividend windfall for each state in the federation. Another headline features Senator Rabiu Musa Kwankwaso, vice-presidential candidate of the Nigeria Democratic Congress (NDC), ruling out withdrawal from the 2027 presidential race in favour of the African Democratic Congress (ADC), saying the opposition party offers no better alternative to the ruling All Progressives Congress (APC). Vanguard also reports that revenue collected by Nigeria’s electricity Distribution Companies (DisCos) rose by about 450 per cent in eight years, from N218.16 billion in the first half of 2018 to N1.2 trillion in the corresponding period of 2026, far outpacing growth in electricity supply over the period. Another newspaper, The Guardian, reports that rising rents are outpacing household incomes and forcing tenants into hard trade-offs. The Punch leads with the Federal Government faulting the World Bank’s assessment of Nigeria’s debt position, dismissing concerns that interest payments of N7.7 trillion in the first half of 2026 threaten the country’s debt sustainability. Lastly, The Nation reports that the NDC may be on another collision course with the Obidient Movement after withdrawing recognition of its chapters operating outside Nigeria. Vanguard News The post Nigerian newspapers review: Presidency, Makinde in verbal war over N250bn NLNG dividend appeared first on Vanguard News .

item.title: Japan launching bold sample-return mission to Mars moon Phobos today: Watch it live
item.description: null Japan will launch an epic mission to Mars today (Oct. 19), and you can watch the action live. The Martian Moons eXploration ( MMX ) mission is scheduled to lift off atop an H3 rocket from Japan's Tanegashima Space Center today at 3:41 p.m. EDT (1941 GMT; 4:41 a.m. on Oct. 20 local Japan time). You can watch it live via the Japan Aerospace Exploration Agency (JAXA). Coverage will begin at 2:45 p.m. EDT (1845 GMT). An artist’s concept of JAXA’s MMX spacecraft during its Mars orbit insertion. The Martian moon Phobos, which MMX will explore and sample, is in the background. (Image credit: JAXA) As its full name suggests, MMX will focus on Mars ' two moons, Phobos and Deimos . They're both tiny compared to Earth's own moon; Phobos is just 14 miles (22 kilometers) wide, and Deimos is even smaller, with a diameter of about 8 miles (13 km). They're also quite mysterious. While astronomers have a pretty clear understanding of our own moon's birth — it coalesced from material blasted into space when a Mars-sized planet slammed into Earth long ago — there's no consensus about Phobos and Deimos' origin story. The duo "may be the remains of a massive impact on Mars that sent material into orbit around the planet, or they could be ancient asteroids that were captured by Mars' gravity billions of years ago," Tom Statler, MMX program executive and program scientist at NASA Headquarters, said in an Oct. 15 statement . (NASA is a partner on the mission, providing a scientific instrument, a technology demonstration, communication support and funding for American scientists on the MMX team.) "Having the answer will help illuminate that early era when Earth and the other inner planets may have been acquiring much of their water and organic compounds," Statler added. MMX will help provide that answer, if all goes according to plan. The spacecraft will arrive in the Mars system in August 2027, then slip into orbit around Phobos a month later. It will study that moon and Deimos from a distance for about 18 months, then deploy the French-German Idefix rover onto Phobos' surface in early 2029. The 55-pound (25 kilograms) Idefix "has two main tasks: providing information to prepare for the landing of the main spacecraft to collect samples, and analyzing the composition and texture of Phobos' surface," European Space Agency officials wrote in an MMX mission description . "The gravity on Phobos is so low that Idefix will only weigh the equivalent of 15 grams [0.5 ounces] on its surface!" they added. The MMX mothership's Phobos landing will occur in 2030. The spacecraft will grab at least 10 grams (0.4 ounces) of samples from the moon, then head back toward Earth with this extraterrestrial bounty. MMX's return capsule will land here in 2031, after which scientists around the world will scrutinize the Phobos sample for clues about the history and evolution of Mars and our solar system more broadly. (NASA is a partner on the mission, providing a scientific instrument, a technology demonstration, communication support and funding for American scientists on the MMX team.) MMX will help provide that answer, if all goes according to plan. The spacecraft will arrive in the Mars system in August 2027, then slip into orbit around Phobos a month later. "The gravity on Phobos is so low that Idefix will only weigh the equivalent of 15 grams [0.5 ounces] on its surface!" they added. The MMX mothership's Phobos landing will occur in 2030. The spacecraft will grab at least 10 grams (0.4 ounces) of samples from the moon, then head back toward Earth with this extraterrestrial bounty. MMX's return capsule will land here in 2031, after which scientists around the world will scrutinize the Phobos sample for clues about the history and evolution of Mars and our solar system more broadly. Engineers conduct a thermal vacuum test with JAXA's MMX Mars moon sample-return spacecraft. JAXA posted this image on X on May 15, 2025. (Image credit: JAXA) MMX was originally supposed to launch in 2024, but issues with the H3 rocket prevented it from doing so. Mars and Earth align properly for interplanetary launches just once every 26 months, so MMX had to wait a while for its next chance. Japan already has an impressive sample-return track record. The country's Hayabusa mission brought home pieces of the asteroid Itokawa in 2010, for example, and Hayabusa2 did the same with material from the space rock Ryugu a decade later.

item.title: Musk says will give SpaceX share to ‘every kid in America’
item.description: Tech billionaire Elon Musk said on Monday that he would give every child in the United States a share in his SpaceX rocket company. “Next year, I will give one of my SpaceX shares to every kid in America,” Musk, the richest man in the world, said on X. “This will be the first of many,” he said, without providing details about how the scheme would work. There are around 73 million children under the age of 18 in the United States, according to 2024 data from the US Census Bureau. Musk owns 38 percent of SpaceX, according to Forbes. His announcement comes after President Donald Trump promised last month to give every American adult $5,000 if his Republican party retains control of Congress in November’s midterm elections. SpaceX set the record for the largest initial public offering in history, raising $85.7 billion in June. The company’s Starship megarocket reached orbit for the first time in September, a milestone for the rocket central to Musk’s Mars ambitions. The post Musk says will give SpaceX share to ‘every kid in America’ appeared first on Vanguard News .

item.title: Bauchi: Witchcraft claim sparks violent attack as police arrest 17
item.description: By Christopher Ameh, Bauchi The Bauchi state police command has arrested 17 suspects over an alleged witchcraft accusation that triggered a violent attack on a family in Gobirawa Village, Alkaleri Local Government Area of the state. The suspects allegedly attacked a 60-year-old man and his family after accusing the man’s son of witchcraft following the death of a 20-year-old resident, identified as Halilu Ahmad, on October 16, 2026. The incident occurred around 1am on October 18, when the suspects allegedly invaded the victim’s residence armed with machetes and sticks, inflicting multiple injuries on him and his 30-year-old son. The attackers were also alleged to have damaged two motorcycles belonging to the family. The police said preliminary investigations indicated that the attack was triggered by the suspects’ belief that the victim’s son was responsible for the death through witchcraft. Due to the deteriorating condition of the 60-year-old victim, he was initially taken to General Hospital, Alkaleri, before being referred to Ihsan Hospital, Bauchi, for further treatment. Police spokesman SP Nafiu Habib, who disclosed this in a statement on Monday, said detectives attached to Alkaleri Division arrested the 17 suspects following the incident. He said the commissioner of police, Sani-Omolori Aliyu, had directed the transfer of the case to the State Criminal Investigation Department, SCID, Bauchi, for discreet investigation and the arrest of three other suspects still at large. The police spokesman quoted the commissioner as warning against accusations of witchcraft and other unverified superstitious beliefs that could lead to violence and the unlawful punishment of innocent persons. Aliyu urged residents to report suspicions, grievances and criminal allegations to the police rather than resorting to self-help or jungle justice. He assured the public that the command would pursue justice in the case and would not tolerate actions capable of threatening public peace and security. The post Bauchi: Witchcraft claim sparks violent attack as police arrest 17 appeared first on Vanguard News .

item.title: Microsoft’s second-hand licensing appeal gets the brush-off
item.description: Microsoft has failed to win permission to appeal to the UK Supreme Court in the long-running legal spat with ValueLicensing after the Court of Appeal refused its application. The US megacorp was challenging a November 2025 ruling in ValueLicensing's favor that VL may resell pre-owned software licenses. That judgment was unambiguous, but Microsoft told The Register at the time that it would seek permission to appeal. That request was rejected last week in blunt terms. No reasons were given for the refusal, just the words "It is ordered that the application is refused." It isn't quite the end of the road. Microsoft could apply to the Supreme Court itself, but it would need to file within 28 days and show a compelling reason why the Court of Appeal was wrong to refuse its appeal. Things are looking dicey for Microsoft in the case that started in 2021 when ValueLicensing sued Microsoft for £270 million over claims that the Windows maker choked off the supply of surplus Office licenses. Microsoft denied any wrongdoing and Instead attempted to reframe the case as a copyright dispute. The UK's Competition Appeal Tribunal rejected Microsoft's arguments and a subsequent appeal. A recently published Consent Order adds to the pressure. It demands documents from past and present Microsoft bosses, including a potentially explosive internal deck titled "Second-Hand Software Presentation" (SHS). The contents of the file are unknown, but the Consent Order refers to it as a "Known Adverse Document." It dates back to 2013, a few years after Office 365 was launched. The order also asks why Microsoft waited until the end of 2025 to disclose the document’s existence, a few years after Office 365 launched. To add a little more spice, Alexander Wolfson is listed as an intervener on the appeal refusal. He is the proposed class representative in a separate claim filed on behalf of millions of UK customers seeking between £1.3 billion to £3.5 billion in compensation from Microsoft over its conduct regarding pre-owned licenses. ValueLicensing and Microsoft declined to comment on the latest development. Appeals aside, the next stage will be a Witness Statement from Microsoft explaining who knew what and when, followed by further disclosure. ®

item.title: 2027: APC says Tinubu’s re-election non-negotiable, pledges violence-free campaigns
item.description: By Omeiza Ajayi, Abuja The ruling All Progressives Congress (APC) has reaffirmed the declaration of the Directorate of Security and Intelligence of its Presidential Campaign Council that President Bola Tinubu’s re-election in 2027 is “non-negotiable”, even as the party pledged peaceful and safe campaigns. APC National Chairman, Prof. Nentawe Yilwatda, made the reaffirmation on Sunday evening in Abuja at the inauguration of national and sub-national structures of the Directorate of Security and Intelligence of the APC Presidential Campaign Council. Deputy National Secretary of the party, Prof. Abdulkarim Abubakar Kana SAN, who represented Yilwatda, said the directorate had moved faster than any other arm of the council. He said politicians had much to learn from the military. “We have a lot to learn from the military – the discipline, the alacrity, the organisation… Even as we organise our campaigns, regimentation is very important. “One of my favourite statements from the military is that the unity of this country is non-negotiable, and now today I heard some of our generals saying that victory in this election is non-negotiable,” he said. He also gave the directorate its marching orders. “Before we leave, you must clear the path; you must confirm to us that the venue is safe. When we are there, you must ensure that we are safe and protected. When we leave, you must ensure that the paths and roads are secure. Your committee is the one that will be there ahead of us and remain there even after we leave,” he said. Recalling the state of the country when the APC took over, Kana said, “Our party came in 2015 and met the country in total disarray.” The Minister of Defence and First Secretary of the directorate, General Christopher Musa, said Tinubu’s return was not in doubt and that the task now was to secure the ground for it. “The return of Mr President is not an issue that we should even start worrying about, because God’s willing, he is coming back. The task before us now is to provide the enabling environment for it to happen. The issue of security is paramount and is key to our success. “We must do everything possible to make sure that Nigeria is safe and secure. And our campaigns are peaceful and safe, because I think that is the most critical aspect of what we do,” he said. The Director of Intelligence and Security of the Council, Major General Sarkin Yaki Bello (retd), who inaugurated the structures, said its members must work within the law. “Our duty is to protect Mr President and the people, and not to threaten them, to preserve order, not to create fear, and to support a peaceful democratic process,” he said. He told members what the stakes were. “What is at stake, gentlemen, is the re-election of President Bola Ahmed Tinubu for a second term in office,” Sarkin Yaki said.
